text:
ravi (Partnerships): Heads up 12 small win to share  PolarByte just closed their first production deployment via the GCP Marketplace listing we co-published. Live this morning in europe-west1. :sparkles: https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/details/polarbyte/redwood-connector

marketplace-bot: Listing status: ACTIVE 1 region(s): europe-west1. partner_id=POLARBYTE-101.

zoe (Sales): Amazing! Any revenue commit or ARR guidance we can flag for ops?

ravi (Partnerships): They're on a 12-month dedicated contract for inference capacity. Not disclosing ARR publicly but ops says it qualifies for our marketplace co-sell pipeline. I'll add the paperwork to the partner record.

tyler (Solutions): Tech note: their workload is a mix of long context summarization (6k-12k tokens) and real-time prompts. We shipped a model-slicing config and enabled prefix compression plus sharded KV cache to hit their SLOs. Reduced median p99 from 1.2s -> 480ms in staging.

nina (Product): Nice work. Can we get a 2-line case quote from their CTO for the partner page? Also want a one-sentence callout about our OpenTelemetry tracing integration for their observability story.

zoe (Sales): I'll ping PolarByte contacts now (CTO = Elena). She said she'd be open to a short quote by EOD.

ravi (Partnerships): Market ops confirmed co-sell eligibility. Tagging @marketplace-bot to attach the co-sell meta.

marketplace-bot: Co-sell flag set: TRUE. Attached doc: https://redwood.internal/partners/polarbyte/contract-101 (internal)

tyler (Solutions): For the case study appendix, here's the config snippet we used (internal):
```
deployment_mode: dedicated
model_slicing:
  max_context_tokens: 8192
  slice_overlap: 64
caching:
  sharded_kv: true
  prefix_compression: true
batching:
  max_batch_ms: 16
  preferred_batch_size: 24
tracing: opentelemetry_enabled: true
```

nina (Product): Great. Ravi, can you coordinate a short case study (2 paragraphs + 1 quote) and a screenshot for the newsletter? I'll draft the marketplace highlight once I have the quote.

ravi (Partnerships): On it. Next steps: 1) Zoe to collect CTO quote, 2) Tyler to paste final perf numbers into the appendix, 3) Nina to draft marketplace blurb, 4) Partnerships to publish partner page and social assets. ETA: 48 hours for public-facing materials.

zoe (Sales): Copy  pinging Elena now.

tyler (Solutions): I'll follow up with bench runs and push numbers to the doc in 30m.

ravi (Partnerships): Thanks all 1 nice momentum for our GCP Marketplace play and dedicated conversion story. :raised_hands:
